description: Five effect loops, each switching between sending its input out to a chain and taking it back, and passing that input straight through

params.text: Lit, that line's in jack goes to the SEND jack beside it and its ret. jack goes to OUT; unlit, in goes straight to OUT and SEND is held at 0V
Lit, that line's two in jacks go to the two SEND jacks beside them and its two ret. jacks to its two OUT jacks; unlit, each in goes straight to the OUT on its row and both SEND jacks are held at 0V
Lit, the in jack goes to SEND and the two ret. jacks go to the two OUT jacks; unlit, the in jack is copied to both OUT jacks at 0.71 of its level and SEND is held at 0V

inputs.text: The signal into that row, polyphonic channels and all; it goes to the SEND jack beside it while the button is lit, and to the OUT jack on the same row while it is unlit
The mono signal into the bottom line; while its button is unlit it is copied to both OUT jacks at 0.71 of its level, a centre pan that keeps the pair at the same apparent loudness
The return from that row's effect chain, passed to the OUT jack beside it while the button is lit; while the button is unlit nothing here is read

outputs.text: That row's output: the ret. jack beside it while the button is lit, and the in jack on the same row while it is unlit
The left output of the bottom line: its ret. jack while the button is lit, and the in jack at 0.71 of its level while it is unlit
The right output of the bottom line: its ret. jack while the button is lit, and the in jack at 0.71 of its level while it is unlit
That row's send out to an effect chain, carrying the in jack beside it while the button is lit and held at 0V while it is unlit

notes: every button comes up unlit, so each line passes its input straight to its output and every SEND jack is held at 0V until a button is pressed.
the bottom line takes one mono in jack and gives two OUT jacks, and its two ret. jacks bring back a stereo effect.
a jack is written only when the input feeding it is patched as well; an output whose source is unpatched is held at 0V.
bypassing the whole module in Rack passes each in jack to the OUT jack on its own row.
